top_diagnoses.reasoning_summary: The patient's physical examination findings, including microcephaly, small broad hands with a simian crease, proximal insertion of the thumb, clinodactyly of the fifth finger, stiff muscle tone, confluent eyebrows, long eyelashes, low hairline, excessive body hair, and short neck, are consistent with Cornelia de Lange Syndrome.
The patient's X-ray findings of crowded ribs, hepatomegaly, conductive hearing loss, and delayed bone development are consistent with Zellweger syndrome.

The patient's ultrasonography findings of hepatomegaly, thin skin, and hearing loss are consistent with PMM2-CDG, but the overall clinical presentation is less consistent with this diagnosis compared to Cornelia de Lange Syndrome and Zellweger syndrome.
